headline: Cyberattacks on supermarket freezers affect at least 11 European countries
summary: Refrigeration failures caused by cyberattacks forced supermarkets in at least 11 European countries to discard food, putting retail digital security on high alert.
why: Supermarket supply chains and retail store operations depend on stable refrigeration and connected internet-of-things infrastructure.

impacts.name: Supermarkets
impacts.why: Cyberattacks on refrigeration systems forced food disposals across multiple European countries.
